requirement: A food place's Menu is two research parts (menu file, menu photos) read again by Read menu again within a per-place photo limit; the Facebook logo is the profile picture file, a silent social search is asked once more, and the Research again preview holds every call a run can make

oracle.ref: PR #1687 (feat); fix evidence: Stand, Fern Hollow Al Barari (24/10/2026): 11 Google Maps menu photos but menu: 0 and Research again said up to date; the build agent invented dishes. Iron Fence Saigon: the Facebook logo was the photo page link (HTML), so the place lost its logo; its Instagram search got no answer and was not asked again. tasks/todo-wo-menu-items.md
oracle.invariant: S1: menu-file and menu-photos are research and Try again parts; the setting clamps to 0..60 with 24 as default; file dishes win, other prices are kept with their photo; a non-food place without dishes has menu null; parts accepts a list or a comma string, absent keeps every part, an unknown part is refused. S2: at most the limit is read; exact duplicate bytes are never sent; a photo with the same bytes under a new URL keeps its reading; the version changes with model or prompt, not with the limit. S3: the food place's menu-photos part is read once and shown as the Menu; nothing to read answers up to date; a new vision model reads only the frozen photos; a non-food place has no menu parts; the account's run holds the menu parts only and is its own to pay. S4: facebook rows stamped before facebook-2 and google-places rows before google-places-2 are due again (rule-changed); the preview ceiling is at least the cost of every call the run can make. S5: the Facebook logo is the profilePic* file (fbcdn), never the profilePhoto page link; a search with no HTTP answer is asked once more, a second silence fails the network, an answered refusal is not asked twice; facts carry primaryType and types. S6: no menu block for a non-food place; prices stay as printed; photo result lines; a Read menu again plan that would run a part outside the menu is caught.
